role: Advisory factual review; human user explicitly authorizes publication conditional on principal and Jev review; Jev never grants authority or performs writes.
objective: Publish a correction separating TSE registration judgment, competition status, aptitude flags and appeal, preserving unresolved official disagreement.
rules: Candidate identity is anchored by exact election2026, SQ, office and UF, never by name alone.
Different official judgments are shown together as Fontes oficiais divergentes; do not choose one as definitive.
Indeferido and Concorrendo may coexist. Do not infer exclusion from the judgment.
Apto=false and inapto=false remain literal flags; neither implies removal.
An absent appeal field means Desconhecido; it does not establish no appeal or an appeal.
Only existing situacao_candidatura and verificacao_campos are updated. Other metadata/status/publicavel must be preserved.

Publishing means code through PR/CI/deploy, then exactly3 existing DB rows via transaction+before-value CAS, followed by cache/public visual proof. Issue remains open because Ricardo conflict persists.

evaluation.mode: consultative probe with synthetic controls; not a calibrated automated production judge
